news.text: SlideDP is now on arXiv: scaling host-resident LLM fine-tuning across multiple GPUs.
Released an updated SlideFormer runtime with a fine-grained chunked pipeline and reproducibility scripts.
Our DAC 2026 paper on SlideFormer is available on arXiv.

publications.title: SlideDP: Scaling Host-Resident LLM Fine-Tuning Across Multiple GPUs
publications.description: Synchronous data parallelism with one authoritative host state and coordinated parameter delivery, gradient aggregation, and CPU updates.
publications.code_note: Reference extension released; full runtime forthcoming.

publications.title: An Efficient Heterogeneous Co-Design for Fine-Tuning on a Single GPU
publications.description: Layer-sliding execution and asynchronous CPU/GPU/NVMe pipelines enable full-parameter fine-tuning beyond the memory capacity of a single GPU.

publications.title: Efficient Mask Learning for Language Model Fine-Tuning
publications.description: Efficient adaptive mask learning for parameter-efficient language model fine-tuning.
